name: Pocket Board 3D
short_description: A polished offline 3D carrom-style board game with smooth touch controls.
long_description: Pocket Board 3D is an original offline tabletop game with a tactile 3D board, local play, simple controls, and persistent local progress. No account or internet connection is required for the base game.
note: Listing artwork must be original and must not copy another app's branding or proprietary assets.
